meta.name: Kakinada town core (pilot 01)
meta.crs: local metres (equirectangular) from SW corner; GeoJSON-style lon/lat via origin + m_per_deg
meta.statement: Experimental planning and visualisation prototype. Values are indicative scenario indices, not forecasts.

facilities.name: Sree Bala Nursing Home Sree Bala Ent Care Centre

layers.title: Terrain elevation
layers.source_name: Copernicus GLO-90 DEM (via Open-Meteo elevation API)
layers.processing_method: 21x21 samples, 3x3 smoothing x2, bilinear upsample to 12.5 m grid, then priority-flood depression filling toward the lowest (downstream) edge so surface water can route; terrain index uses the unfilled surface. GLO-90 is a surface model (includes buildings/trees).
layers.known_limitations: Coarse, noisy in built-up areas; cannot resolve kerbs, culverts or underpasses. Sub-metre relief is not reliable.

layers.title: Buildings (472)
layers.processing_method: Footprints clipped to the pilot extent; heights from OSM tags where present, otherwise a proxy of 2-4 storeys (visualisation only).
layers.known_limitations: OSM completeness varies - the area is likely under-mapped. Default heights are a proxy.

layers.title: Road network (250 segments)
layers.processing_method: Highway ways clipped to extent; widths assigned by class; rasterised to the 12.5 m grid and lowered 0.15 m in the solver (assumed kerb-channel effect).
layers.known_limitations: Width, kerb height and drainage by class are assumptions.

layers.title: Critical facilities (23)
layers.processing_method: Amenity nodes/ways; building polygons reduced to centroids; near-duplicates merged.
layers.known_limitations: Mapped facilities only; capacity, status and shelter suitability unknown. Not a verified emergency inventory.

layers.title: Water bodies (4)
layers.processing_method: natural=water polygons clipped to extent; display only.
layers.known_limitations: Display only; not coupled into the solver.

layers.title: Storm-drain inlets (56, proxy)
layers.processing_method: Farthest-point sampling along drivable roads (even spread, no terrain bias); each inlet carries an assumed capacity in the solver.
layers.known_limitations: No surveyed drainage inventory was available. Locations, capacity and blockage are scenario assumptions, not an inspection record. Do not use to infer where real drains are.

layers.title: Rainfall input
layers.native_resolution_or_scale: uniform over the pilot area (IMERG native: ~0.1 deg / 30 min, too coarse for street level)
layers.processing_method: Total depth over a chosen duration, distributed with a triangular-peaked hyetograph.
layers.known_limitations: Spatially uniform; no antecedent moisture; no real event calibration.

layers.title: Analysis zones (100 m)
layers.processing_method: Terrain, drainage vulnerability and exposure normalised to 0-1 and combined with provisional weights 0.30/0.25/0.25/0.20.
layers.known_limitations: Indicative relative index. Not a probability, not calibrated, not a depth estimate.
